notes_zh:
### AI Agent Bridge（核心新功能）

- **新增** AI Agent 集成：在 设置 → AI Agent 中一键安装到 Claude Code / Cursor / Codex 等 MCP 客户端，让 AI 助手直接读取剪贴板历史、搜索过往内容、写回文本
- **新增** AI Agent 集成总开关 + 黑名单：可一键关闭整个 MCP Bridge，也可配置不允许 AI 读取的来源 App（#50，感谢 @Zxxxxxl 的反馈）
- **新增** 列表行和详情面板的 AI Agent 来源徽标：圆点 + 名称显示某条剪贴板是哪个 AI 助手写入的
- **新增** Onboarding 引导：首次启动会介绍 AI Agent 功能（11 国本地化）
- **改进** 历史搜索支持深翻页：AI Agent 可以分批读取超长剪贴板历史，不会丢失上下文

### 修复

- **修复** 主窗口侧栏「按应用」分组里不活跃 App 的图标显示错乱、和其他 App 错配成同一个图标（#52，感谢 @Zxxxxxl 的反馈）
- **修复** 保留期 +「永久保存」分组同时启用时，组内超过保留期的条目从列表 / 快捷面板消失但还在数据库里，导致再次复制相同内容静默并入隐藏老条目，用户感知为「这串字复制不上」
- **修复** 从 Telegram 复制 TIFF 图片粘贴到 Finder 后，文件后缀错成 `.png`、Finder 大图标无法显示缩略图（#48，感谢 @xream 的反馈）
- **修复** 从 Telegram 复制图片粘贴到 Finder 文件夹时，出现 174 字节的「替身」文件、无法预览
- **修复** 切换状态栏图标「描边 / 填充」样式后不立即生效，必须等剪贴板内容变化才更新
- **修复** 详情面板的文件大小现在跟随符号链接，显示链接指向的实际文件大小

### 体验改进

- **改进** 顶部菜单「文件 → 导入数据」改用独立进度面板（解密 → 导入 → 刷新主界面 → 结果摘要），把解密 / 解析挪到后台线程不再卡住主线程让光标转圈；导入完成的成功提示直接整合在面板里（「已导入 N 条 / 跳过 M 条 / 新增分组 K 个 / 新增规则 L 个」），不再额外弹一个 alert
- **改进** 设置面板的导入流程一致化：解密 / 刷新等无确定百分比的阶段显示滚动动画；导入结束前同步刷新所有打开的窗口，避免主窗口先空一段再「突然出现数据」
- **改进** 快捷面板的「AI Agent」过滤标签移到 tab 栏末尾

notes_en:
### AI Agent Bridge (Major New Feature)

- **New** AI Agent integration: one-click install into Claude Code / Cursor / Codex (or any MCP client) via Settings → AI Agent. Let AI assistants read clipboard history, search past clips, and write text back
- **New** Master toggle + per-app blocklist for the AI Agent bridge: shut the whole MCP server off with one switch, or block specific source apps from being read by agents (#50, thanks @Zxxxxxl for the report)
- **New** AI Agent source badge in both clip rows and the detail pane: see which AI assistant wrote a given clipboard item (colored dot + name)
- **New** Onboarding step introducing the AI Agent feature on first launch (11 languages)
- **Improve** Deep history pagination: agents can page through large clipboard histories without losing context

### Fixes

- **Fix** Sidebar "by app" section showed wrong / mismatched icons for apps that hadn't been used recently — every fallback row collapsed onto the same wrong icon (#52, thanks @Zxxxxxl for the report)
- **Fix** When a retention period (Settings → Pro → Retention) was configured alongside a "preserve items" group, items in that group would silently disappear from the list / quick panel once they aged past the cutoff — yet still live in the database and still win duplicate detection. The next copy of the same content silently merged into the hidden row, so users saw nothing happen and assumed "this string won't copy"
- **Fix** TIFF images copied from Telegram now save with the correct extension and preview properly in Finder, instead of landing as a `.png` file Finder couldn't render (#48, thanks @xream for the report)
- **Fix** Pasting an image from Telegram into a Finder folder no longer produces a broken 174-byte "alias" file
- **Fix** Menu bar icon "outline / filled" style toggle now takes effect right away, instead of waiting for the next clipboard change
- **Fix** File size in the detail panel now follows symlinks, showing the actual target file's size instead of the link's

### Polish

- **Improve** Top-menu **File → Import** now uses a dedicated progress panel (decrypt → import → refresh main view → result summary). Decrypt + parse run off the main actor so the cursor no longer spins on large files. The success summary ("Imported N, skipped M, +K groups, +L rules") is folded into the same panel — no separate alert
- **Improve** Settings panel import gets the same polish: an indeterminate spinner during non-measurable stages, and a synchronous refresh pass before the sheet dismisses so the main window doesn't flash empty after a large import
- **Improve** Quick panel's "AI Agent" filter tab moved to the end of the tab bar
